title: Google Breadcrumb
statusNote: Active. data-vocabulary.org markup no longer eligible.
notes: item and name are checked as recommended only: item is not required for the last breadcrumb and name is not required when item is a Thing with its own name.
Not checked: a BreadcrumbList needs at least two ListItems.
BreadcrumbList needs at least two ListItems.
ListItem.item is a URL or a Thing (use @id for the URL in JSON-LD); item is NOT required for the last breadcrumb (Google uses the containing page URL).
ListItem.name is not required if item is a Thing that has its own name. position is an Integer starting at 1.
